flags.name: Avocado Hass
flags.issue: Sold and costed BY THE TRAY with no count, and needs_pack_review is FALSE so nothing else will surface it. The feed holds pack_qty 1, pack_unit 'tray', $22.00 per tray. A recipe that adds one avocado books $22.00. Our own cost book prices a single avocado at $3.10 each (Select Fresh AVOE, invoice 3068987, 2026-06-27), so the error is roughly 7-20x depending on the true count, and it is in the direction that HURTS GP rather than flatters it — but it is equally wrong either way and it is live in the picker now.
flags.suggested_fix: Set a pack count for AH20T (pack_overrides.yaml) so the tray divides into units. THE COUNT WAS NOT GUESSED AND IS NOT STATED ANYWHERE IN OUR DATA. Evidence available: the supplier's own code is 'AH20T' and invoice INB00115735 (2026-08-18) prints raw_uom 'Tray', qty 1, $22.00 — no count. The '20' in the code is suggestive but a code is not a fact, and the tray count for Hass varies with fruit size (a 20-count and a 25-count tray are both standard). Zak or the chef needs to count one tray, or confirm it with Fresh Fruit Team. Cross-check once known: $22.00/20 = $1.10 vs $22.00/25 = $0.88, both below the Select Fresh loose price of $3.10, which is expected for tray buying.
flags.money: a recipe adding one avocado books a whole tray

flags.name: Peppers Roasted Red (Capsicum) 2.35kg Marco Polo
flags.issue: Costed on the NET tin weight, which may include the brine. The feed reads 2350 g at $0.010213/g ($10.21/kg) from the description '2.35KG'; the invoice states raw_uom 'EA' and no drained weight. A recipe uses the peppers, not the liquid they are packed in, so if 2.35 kg is the net fill the true rate is higher and the current one flatters GP — the direction CLAUDE.md names as the dangerous one. Flagged because this is the SAME class as triage item 27: the Gulli A12 tin's spec sheet gave NET 4200 g against DRAINED 2500 g, a 1.68x difference, and the drained figure is the one the cost book uses for that product today.
flags.suggested_fix: Confirm the DRAINED weight of the Marco Polo 2.35 kg roasted red pepper tin and, if it differs from 2.35 kg, add a pack_overrides.yaml entry in grams keyed foodlink:100442. NOT GUESSED: no drained weight appears on invoice SI4529423, in any other Foodlink invoice for this code, or anywhere in data/. It needs the supplier spec sheet or a weigh-and-drain in the kitchen. If 2.35 kg turns out to BE the drained weight, no change is needed — record that here so this does not get re-raised.
flags.money: up to ~1.7x understated on any recipe using roasted peppers, if the tin follows the A10/A12 pattern

notes: THE FOODLINK PACK SIZES ARE BACK, and this batch is the proof that triage item 33 worked. Sixteen of the 36 new products are Foodlink, and every one of them carries a full name AND a parsed pack: 'ALMOND MEAL 1KG Natures Secret' 1000 g, 'BREADCRUMBS JAPANESE PANKO YELLOW 10KG John Bull' 10000 g, 'CHEESE BLUE DANISH 10X100GM Viking' 1000 g, 'VINEGAR WHITE 20LT Edlyn' 20000 ml. Before 2026-08-17 the wrapped half of these descriptions — which is where Foodlink states the size — was being dropped, and each of these would have entered as a sizeless 'per ea' row with needs_pack_review set. Not one product in this batch needs pack review.
